basis.ordering_convention: PBW: κ < [odd] < [even]  (K = 1 is excluded; see central_elements)

kappa.description: Formal central symbol for the nilpotent extension; recorded explicitly in the schema and excluded from basis lists.

K.description: Central identity element; recorded for completeness and excluded from basis lists.

inhomogeneous_deformation.gamma_target_convention: Z ranges over the Schema 1 basis generators plus K when constant terms appear; kappa is factored out.
